commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Ferran Torres (Spain) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Uruguay will have a goal kick.
90+5' Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
90+3' Unsporting behaviour by Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay).
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) was quite harsh and Ismail Elfath didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+2' The game is interrupted as Nico Williams (Spain) is flagged offside.

90' A player from Uruguay commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90' Yeremy Pino (Spain) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
87' Yeremy Pino (Spain) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

86' OFF THE BAR! Ferran Torres (Spain) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball goes out of play and Uruguay will have a goal kick.

85' Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but is stopped by a great save from Unai Simon and the score remains the same.
85' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) heads on.
84' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 4:5. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
83' Maximiliano Araujo (Uruguay) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

82' Mathias Olivera (Uruguay) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Unai Simon pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

81' A cross by Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Spain.
80' Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) forces a pass into the box, but Unai Simon is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
79' Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.

62' Dani Olmo (Spain) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

58' Spain will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' What was Guillermo Varela (Uruguay) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

16' Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
16' Alex Baena (Spain) will deliver the corner kick.

15' Lamine Yamal (Spain) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
13' Dangerous play by Rodrigo Bentancur (Uruguay). Ismail Elfath blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Spain will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

12' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) offside.
11' Flag up against Lamine Yamal (Spain). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

8' The corner from Lamine Yamal (Spain) is hurriedly cleared. Spain have been awarded a corner kick.

4' Aymeric Laporte (Spain) commits a rough challenge and Ismail Elfath blows his whistle for an infringement. Uruguay are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
